overview: Global technological and geopolitical updates lead the morning headlines, highlighted by new artificial intelligence security discoveries and strategic bridge damage in Crimea. In commercial real estate markets, significant capital continues flowing into digital infrastructure and retail assets through large-scale acquisitions. Locally in San Francisco, municipal policy shifts include the collapse of a controversial historic preservation bill following housing pushback. Meanwhile, economic challenges and literary developments shape regional discourse across Hawaii.

items.title: A.I. Helps Find Major Security Bug in Java, a Software Platform Vital to the Internet
items.summary: Security researchers discovered a major A.I.-detected flaw in Java that could impact systems used by nearly all Fortune 500 companies.

items.title: Putin's Crimean Bridge partly collapses as Zelensky hails 'unprecedented' attack by Ukraine
items.summary: The Crimean Bridge partly collapsed following an attack by Ukraine that officials described as unprecedented.

items.title: Trump’s New A.I. Chip Rules Rattle Southeast Asia
items.summary: New U.S. restrictions on artificial intelligence chips could jeopardize billions in investment and strain diplomatic balances in Southeast Asia.

items.title: Blue Owl Acquires Northern Virginia Data Center for $780M
items.summary: Blue Owl Capital acquired a 54-megawatt data center in Northern Virginia for nearly $780 million to expand its digital infrastructure portfolio.

items.title: Cubline Properties Seals $889M of Convenience Retail Acquisitions in 2026
items.summary: Curbline Properties amassed $889 million in convenience retail acquisitions throughout 2026 as the nation's largest convenience retail owner.

wiki.title: Islands: Non-Places
wiki.extract: Islands: Non-Places is a 2016 abstract art game developed and published independently by artist and animator Carl Burton, who is best known for the animated GIF illustrations he created for season two of the Serial podcast. The game was released on November 17, 2016, on iOS, Windows, Mac, and Linux, and consists of a series of anonymous, liminal environments – the eponymous "non-places". These scenes appear mundane at first, but become increasingly surreal as the player interacts with the objects within.

otd.text: Tatarstan Airlines Flight 363 crashed during an aborted landing at Kazan International Airport, Russia, killing all 50 people on board and leading to the revocation of the airline's operating certificate.
